claims: Mustill, A. J. and Wyatt, M. C. 2012, A general model of planetary chaotic zones, MNRAS 419, 3074: for stretched orbits the overlap zone is 1.8 (mu e)^(1/5). doi:10.1111/j.1365-2966.2011.19951.x

…. Kepler's third law turns δa/a into 3/2 of that in the period ratio. Wisdom 1980 and Mustill and Wyatt 2012: closer than 1.3 μ^(2/7), or 1.8 (μ e)^(1/5) for stretched orbits, neighbouring resonances overlap and the motion is chaotic, so nothing is held there…
Murray and Dermott 1999 section 8.7, eq. 8.76; Dermott and Murray 1981 section 4; Wisdom 1980 eq. 29; Mustill and Wyatt 2012 section 3
